people.name: Baruch
people.line: Jeremiah's scribe who recorded and delivered his prophecies.

translations.web: They asked Baruch, saying, “Tell us now, how did you write all these words at his mouth?”
translations.bsb: “Tell us now,” they asked Baruch, “how did you write all these words? Was it at Jeremiah’s dictation?”
translations.kjv: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
translations.asv: And they asked Baruch, saying, Tell us now, How didst thou write all these words at his mouth?
